subject: Pricing variance request for TopLine Health Hosted API commit
messages:
From: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@toplinehealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Jason Li <jason.li@toplinehealth.com>, procure@toplinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing for multi-region annual commit

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile and batching behavior look very promising for our ingestion pipeline. We’re preparing an enterprise purchase request for a multi-region deployment (US + EU) and have an internal target unit cost that’s roughly 28% below your published Hosted API list rate.

High level asks:
- 24 month commitment across US & EU (estimated 18M tokens/mo year 1 ramping to 40M tokens/mo year 2)
- Prefer a usage-based model with a blended per-token rate and a 12-month introductory lower rate for adoption
- Need SOC2 evidence, signed DPA, and invoice terms (net 45)

Can Redwood support a deeper discount (we are asking ~25–30% off list for the first 12 months) as part of the commitment? If so, we’ll move forward with procurement and legal and can provide an LOI.

Attached: TLH_RFP_2027.pdf

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Reyes
VP, Cloud Infrastructure
TopLine Health
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for multi-region annual commit

Ben / Karthik — forwarding TLH request. Short summary below and my recommendation.

Summary:
- TopLine is proposing a large commitment (US + EU) with substantial ramp (40M tokens/mo by year 2).
- They ask for ~25–30% off list for first 12 months. They will do a 24-month overall commitment but want the introductory concession for adoption.
- Requires SOC2, DPA, net45 invoicing — OK from our side but Legal will need to finalize DPA.

Recommended commercial concession: 25% off list for months 1–12, revert to standard committed tier in months 13–24. Conditions: signed 24-month commitment at a defined monthly minimum ($85k/month MRR equivalent), no custom SLA beyond standard unless we add professional services (billable). Require prepay or monthly invoices with 30-day payment terms where possible — if they insist on net45, Finance wants a one-time onboarding credit holdback.

Impact: preliminary cost_impact_spreadsheet attached. This concession reduces gross margin on Hosted API token revenue by ~18–22% year 1 depending on actual usage. Strategic rationale: TopLine is a reference to win other national health systems and expands our EU footprint.

As this is >20% discount to list, I’m requesting formal exec/discount approval and any deal-desk guardrails you want included. If approved, I’ll prepare quote_v3.pdf and SOW_v2.docx and route to procurement.

— Priyom
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 Oct 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing request from TopLine — strategic partner ask

Marissa — flagging this one for your review. Priyom recommends 25% for first 12 months tied to a 24-month commit. We should treat TopLine as a strategic reference in healthcare; the EU expansion is valuable.

Key points for approval committee:
- Requested concession: 25% off list for months 1–12 (revert month 13)
- Minimum committed spend: $85k/month (12k USD per million tokens baseline pricing assumption)
- Legal items: DPA + SOC2 evidence (Legal / Security comfortable)
- Finance: net45 requested; Finance prefers net30 or prepay — will accept net45 with a one-time onboarding holdback/credit assessed.

HubSpot link: https://hubspot.company/deals/TLH-2027-1030 (see ARR and forecast).

If you’re comfortable, please reply with approval text and any extra conditions (cap on total discounted tokens? reporting cadence?).

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request from TopLine — strategic partner ask

Ben / team — after reviewing the numbers and strategic value, I approve a 25% introductory concession for months 1–12 under the conditions below:

Approval terms (please include in quote):
1) 25% off list for months 1–12 only; months 13–24 charged at the committed tier rate.
2) Signed 24-month commitment with a $85k/month minimum for the first 12 months; we will pro-rate over the term.
3) Finance will accept net45 for this customer contingent on a one-time onboarding holdback equal to one month’s committed billing that will be released after month 2 of payment compliance.
4) Legal to attach a DPA; SOC2 type II report to be provided prior to production access.
5) No additional SLA concessions without separate PS agreement.

Marking this as approved by leadership for a strategic healthcare partner. Kar thik, please update the deal desk record and generate the final quote_v3.pdf. Priyom, you can proceed to send the approved commercial terms to TopLine and attach SOW_v2.docx.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Enterprise
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@toplinehealth.com>
Cc: Jason Li <jason.li@toplinehealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Oct 2027 00:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for multi-region annual commit

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Good news: leadership has approved a one-time introductory concession of 25% off list for months 1–12 under the conditions below.

Approved commercial terms (summary):
- Introductory rate: 25% off list for months 1–12. Months 13–24 billed at the committed tier rate.
- Term: 24-month commitment; $85k/month minimum for months 1–12 (measured as committed monthly billing).
- Payment: Net45 accepted with a one-time onboarding holdback equal to one month’s committed billing; released after two months of on-time payments.
- Compliance: DPA to be executed; SOC2 Type II report provided prior to production access.
- Professional services or custom SLAs billed separately.

I’ve attached the revised commercial quote (quote_v3.pdf) and SOW_v2.docx for review. If this aligns, please confirm and we’ll route to DocuSign.

Attachments: quote_v3.pdf, SOW_v2.docx

Next steps: Confirm LOI or provide any redlines by EOD Wednesday 11/03 and we’ll push the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Thanks — excited to partner with TopLine.
— Priyom
